name: Silicon Valley
description: Counterfactual history of Silicon Valley from Lee de Forest's vacuum tube (1913) to the generative-AI investment surge (2024). Sourced from Michael Houck's 'The Entire History of Silicon Valley' (Founding Journey, 2025) for the venture-capital/company throughline, and Steve Blank's 'Secret History of Silicon Valley' talk/transcript for the WWII/Cold War military-university origin story usually left out of garage-founder mythology. Two structurally complementary lineages: the Terman model (military-funded, institutional, top-down) and the garage-founder model (individual risk-taking, bottom-up).
